title: YAMNet
text: YAMNet sound classification network, 1 input, 3 outputs, no direct feedthrough; {Mini-batch size} sets the size of mini-batches, {Classification} selects to output sound classification and {Predictions} sets the output all scores and associated labels. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: labels
ports.summary: Class labels for predicted scores vector

params.name: Classification
params.values: Select to output sound classification on (default) | off

params.name: Predictions
params.values: Output all scores and associated labels off (default) | on
